title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 6: the sons of Levi, the priestly line from Aaron, the singers David appointed, and the Levites' cities.

questions.text: Who are listed as the sons of Levi in verse 1?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 6:1 says the sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

questions.text: Which Azariah executed the priest's office in the house Solomon built in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest's office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

questions.text: By whose hand did Yahweh carry Judah and Jerusalem away when Jehozadak went into captivity?
questions.explanation: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

questions.text: Who were the sons of Samuel?
questions.explanation: The sons of Samuel were the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

questions.text: According to verse 31, what did David set the listed Levites over?
questions.explanation: These are the ones David set over the service of song in Yahweh's house, after the ark came to rest there.

answers.text: The gates of the city of Jerusalem
The treasuries of the king's house
The service of song in Yahweh's house
The army of Israel in battle

questions.text: According to verse 39, who stood at the right hand of Heman the singer?
questions.explanation: Verse 39 says that Heman's brother Asaph, the son of Berechiah, stood on his right hand.

questions.text: Who offered on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense?
questions.explanation: Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense, and made atonement for Israel.

questions.text: Hebron was given to the sons of Aaron, but to whom were its fields and villages given?
questions.explanation: They gave Hebron and its pasture lands to the sons of Aaron, but the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

questions.text: Which city in the hill country of Ephraim was given to the Kohathites as a city of refuge?
questions.explanation: They gave them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands, and Gezer.

questions.text: Out of which tribe were Ramoth in Gilead and Mahanaim given, with their pasture lands?
questions.explanation: Verse 80 says that out of the tribe of Gad were given Ramoth in Gilead and Mahanaim with their pasture lands.
